question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

She was laughing from the ______ exuberance of the performance.
solution:
The correct answer is "**sheer**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the **given words:**

 
 
• **perfect**: 

 having all the required or desirable elements, qualities, or characteristics; as good as it is possible to be.
